goals.text: Give the Telegram and email platforms the toolsets the config means them to have.

outcomes.change: Telegram and email get the file toolset
outcomes.checked_by: a test that every `platform_toolsets` entry is a known toolset name, no "references unknown toolset" warning in the gateway log, and a Telegram request answered with a file tool

problems.text: Both `platform_toolsets` lists name `files` instead of `file`, so Telegram and email have no file tools.
